europe_now.title: Ukraine allies convene as Russian strikes escalate and air defence runs low
europe_now.summary: Ukraine's allies hold emergency talks as Russian strikes intensify and air defence interceptors run critically low. The meeting aims to secure immediate additional air defence supplies to prevent further civilian casualties.

sources.headline: Live: Ukraine backers gather as Russian attacks escalate, air defence runs low

europe_now.title: Germany develops strategy to contain far-right AfD influence
europe_now.summary: Germany's political establishment is finalizing a strategy to counter the far-right AfD's growing influence in state governments. The plan includes potential legal bans, coalition agreements, and civil society initiatives.

sources.headline: Germany’s establishment has a plan to contain the far right. Sort of.

top_stories.title: Ukraine war escalation prompts urgent international air defence talks
top_stories.summary: Ukraine's international backers are convening urgently as Russian attacks escalate and Ukrainian air defence supplies run low. The discussions center on expediting deliveries of advanced air defence systems, including Patriot missiles, to protect civilian areas.

sources.headline: Live: Ukraine backers gather as Russian attacks escalate, air defence runs low

top_stories.title: German mainstream parties coordinate strategy against far-right AfD
top_stories.summary: German mainstream parties are developing a coordinated strategy to contain the far-right Alternative for Germany party, especially in eastern regions. The plan involves legal, political, and societal measures but its effectiveness remains uncertain.

sources.headline: Germany’s establishment has a plan to contain the far right. Sort of.

top_stories.title: UK settled status system erroneously merges identical twins' records
top_stories.summary: The United Kingdom's post-Brexit settled status system has mistakenly merged the records of identical twins who are EU citizens. The error raises concerns about the reliability of the immigration database affecting thousands of European residents.

sources.headline: Britain told EU citizens to trust its settled status system. Then it mixed up identical twins.

top_stories.title: Saudi Crown Prince visits Paris for esports event, deepening bilateral ties
top_stories.summary: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman is visiting Paris for a major esports tournament, showcasing the kingdom's expanding influence in the global gaming sector. The visit highlights strengthening bilateral ties between Saudi Arabia and France beyond traditional energy cooperation.

sources.headline: Saudi Arabia asserts its dominance over Esports as MBS arrives in Paris for 'World Cup'
